messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020 frequency converter 7.5 kW
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer. Our orders with you for part:350020 rose from EUR 400.19 (po:4500012924-10) to EUR 412.74 (po:4500014465-10) between 2025-09-15 and 2026-09-28. That rise is already in our price. Our should-cost estimate for part:350020 is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020), below your price. The forecast for part:350020 increased by 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

On volume: we plan 4580 pcs per year and offer a 24 month commitment, which gives your plant secure planning. The attached packages pair that commitment with payment terms that ease your cash flow. Could you also confirm your earliest lead time?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020 frequency converter 7.5 kW
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the price history and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.

We have reviewed your verified data regarding the price history and should-cost estimate, and we value the proposed 24-month commitment. Based on this extended contract duration, we can offer a revised price of EUR 427.96 per unit under your preferred 30-day payment terms.

Our current Angebot consists of a price of €427.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our colleagues will contact you shortly to confirm the earliest lead time for this volume.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – revised packages within your price freeze
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for the revised offer and for valuing our 24-month commitment. We respect your head office's position on price reductions. None of the attached packages goes below the price of our current agreement ctr:4600070530, so they stay within that freeze.

As you were open on payment terms, two packages return to the payment terms of our current agreement. This keeps your price level stable and keeps our cash position unchanged. The third package keeps your 30-day terms.

On volume, all packages cover 4580 pcs per year for 24 months. Could you confirm your earliest possible lead time and tell us which package you can sign?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – revised packages within your price freeze
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We appreciate your understanding regarding our corporate price freeze until December 2027. Due to this strict mandate, we cannot accommodate the price levels in your recent packages and must maintain our offer of a price of €427.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our colleagues will contact you shortly to confirm the earliest possible lead time.

Please note that this Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 - revised packages for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for confirming your position and for checking the lead time. We have moved toward your offer in all three attached packages.

As you were open on payment terms, two packages pair the price with the payment terms of our current agreement ctr:4600070530. The third keeps your 30-day terms. All packages cover 4580 pcs per year over 24 months, which gives your plant secure planning for the full period.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

If one of the packages works better for your cash flow, please tell us which one, and we will close on it quickly.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 - revised packages for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offers and your willingness to move closer to our position.

Under our corporate mandate freezing price reductions until December 2027, we must maintain our price of EUR 427.96 for the 30-day payment terms. Our current Angebot comprises a price of €427.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This package provides you with the most advantageous pricing, as extended payment terms would result in a higher unit price.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our margin and our limits stay internal.

This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
